projectDescription: Multi-tenant employee scheduling platform for care facilities, replacing spreadsheets with a modern web app featuring real-time collaboration, drag-and-drop shift management, and role-based access control.
keyFeatures: Schedule Grid with 1-week, 2-week, and month views and drag-and-drop shift management
Draft/Publish workflow — all edits are drafts until explicitly published
Real-time collaboration with cell locks and presence indicators
Recurring shifts — day-of-week templates and repeating series
Shift pickup and swap requests with admin approval workflow
Dashboard analytics — KPI cards, coverage charts, activity feeds
Staff management — full employee lifecycle with certifications and roles
Coverage requirements — define and visualize minimum staffing levels
Role-based access control with four-tier hierarchy and 16 granular admin permissions
Print export with configurable layout, legend, and date range
Calendar export (ICS) for personal schedule sync
publicApiSurface: GET /api/calendar — Export authenticated user's shifts as an ICS calendar file
GET /api/export?type=staff|schedule — Export staff roster or schedule as CSV
POST /api/send-invite-email — Send invitation email to a new employee
GET /api/validate-domain — Check if an org subdomain slug is available
POST /api/request-demo — Submit a demo request from the landing page
POST /api/stripe/create-checkout — Create a Stripe checkout session for billing
POST /api/stripe/webhook — Stripe webhook handler for subscription lifecycle events
Supabase RPC change_user_role — Change a user's organization role
